definition: Light — the self-luminous nature of consciousness. In Kashmir Śaivism, prakāśa is the light of consciousness by which all things are known. It is not a physical light but the luminosity of awareness itself. Abhinavagupta: the universe's supreme light (viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ).

sources.claim: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light (viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ).
Prakāśa is the light of consciousness; it is not physical light but the luminosity of awareness.

translations.note: Prakāśa is the self-luminous nature of consciousness. It is not physical light but the luminosity of awareness itself. In Paramārthacarcā, light is unobjectifiable because over-pervasive. (Paramārthacarcā v.1)
